system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We introduce a dynamic complexity cue within the system prompt in order to guide the complexity of artifacts generated by thedraft and improve operators.
system_prompt_style.note: Jinja templates (src/dojo/config_dataclasses/llm/jinjaprompt.py) plus per-node complexity cue and memory injection.

env_context_strategy.note: Task description injected; no navigation tools evidenced.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Memory (running summary of all previous designs, scores, and notes that is appended to everyDraft/Improve prompt).
context_compaction.note: Memory operator is a handcrafted summary; truncate_string in src/dojo/core/solvers/operators/memory.py shortens entries. Each operator call builds fresh context, not a growing history. no_memory option exists.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The environment captures and returns the status, standard outputs, tracebacks for debugging, and the code block execution time to the agents.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: We use Jupyter notebooks to execute code from the agents. With this interface, agents can execute arbitrary Python code
tool_call_format.note: Operators output plan + fenced script, parsed via src/dojo/utils/code_parsing.py.

tool_count.note: No tool-call schema; action is a whole code script. Tool count not applicable/not evidenced.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Draft (3–5-sentence plan + fenced script that trains, evaluates, and writes submission.csv)
edit_primitive.note: Each operator emits a full script.

protocol_standardization.note: No grep result available in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Using these abstractions, we implement and evaluate four search policies: MCTS, Evolutionary, Greedy, and
loop_primitives.note: Default README example is AIRA_GREEDY; MCTS/evo selectable via config. Draft/debug/improve execute-and-fix loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Draft (3–5-sentence plan + fenced script that trains, evaluates, and writes submission.csv)
planning_granularity.note: Plan text stored on nodes but not a maintained plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: all operators are LLM-driven except for theMemory operator, which is defined by hand.
multi_agent_topology.note: One search policy orchestrating LLM operators; not multi-agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: all operators are LLM-driven except for theMemory operator, which is defined by hand.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Nodes track parent-child relationships between solutions
short_term_state.note: Journal of Node objects with code, plan, metrics.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: In contrast, we focus on addressing each competition independently.

self_verification.evidence_quote: We always use GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2024) with Structured Outputs to parse code execution outputs—extracting run success, summary text, and validation metric.
self_verification.note: Harness executes each script and scores it (5-fold CV fitness); analysis LLM parses results.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Parents that are buggy are first processed byDebug until they are either fixed or the debug attempt limit is reached.
retry_policy.note: Search inherently produces many attempts; debug attempts capped.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each coding session starts from the originalSuperimage state and can diverge based on the agent's actions
rollback.note: Search can revisit prior node code, but no filesystem rollback evidenced.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: the termination criterion is set as thewall-clock time or themaximum number of artifacts, whichever happens first
termination_condition.note: Wall-clock termination recorded under F3 per_run; allowed-value list has no wall-clock option.

cost_controls.note: Cost is logged per operator (docs/LOGGING.md) but no cap evidenced.

timeouts.evidence_quote: the agent is allowed a 24-hour wall-clock window. Within this period, each agent has a maximum runtime of 4 hours per code execution.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The environment enforces program-level constraints, such as total runtime limit, GPU and CPU usage, memory, and storage, usingApptainer containers

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: agents possess root-like privileges within their isolated containers, granting them full control over their environment.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Internet access is permitted solely for fetching third-party packages and model checkpoints.
network_policy.note: Experimental setup; enforcement mechanism not shown in repo evidence.

permission_model.evidence_quote: agents can execute arbitrary Python code, perform file reads and writes, and even use the shell via Jupyter magic commands.

tracing.evidence_quote: The journal entries are initially stored as JSONL (one JSON object per line), then processed into the structured journal.json file

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The framework provides a general abstraction for tasks and agents, implements the MLE-bench task
